materials.content: Charcoal on medium thick, cream, moderately textured laid paper; Watermark: MBM (FRANCE) Ingres d'Arches (Source: Paper Survey researched by Judith C. Walsh and published in Lynes, 1999.)

remarks_1999: Not recorded Whitney Archive, Downtown Gallery Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks. (Source: Lynes, 1999)

description: The dark, softly shaded form of a tree stands behind a few layered, sweeping bands of gray that move horizontally across the semiabstract image. The tree's outermost limbs fade into the white of the exposed paper surrounding the composition.
title: Untitled (Trees)
